name: e11-turret-gunner
comment: B: walks to the same tank and asks for a seat one step AFTER DRIVER has booked seat 0,
so the request is refused RejectedOccupied and ClientSeatRequester.TryNextSeat walks to
index 1 -- the Gunner seat, whose MountedTurret.Unholster is the A16 hijack site.
The turret-mounted capture is the FIRST one that can show the outcome: a checkpoint
fires at its step's entry, so the toggle in the seat0-taken step has completed by then.
Read combat.seat.requestsSent beside occupiedVehicleId -- X-65 exists because the record
could not tell a request that was never sent from one that was refused.
The toggle REPEATS because p5-e11-01 measured seat 1 already occupied: AiActorController
seats a bot in the nearest vehicle within 4 m, so the gunner seat is contested. Each
toggle costs two requests (index 0, then index 1 on the refusal), and a later one enters
if the bot has left. Retries do not make the case happen -- they only stop a single
badly-timed sample being read as though the seat were permanently unreachable.
